basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who enjoys playing blues guitar in my free time. I work as a software engineer for a tech startup, which allows me to have flexible working hours. I'm an avid gamer, especially on the PS5, and love exploring new audio equipment for the best gaming experience. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we often travel together, with our most recent trip being to Puerto Rico. I generally browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6 to 10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a degree from the University of Texas. My interest in audio equipment comes from a mix of my passion for music and gaming, leading me to self-teach about sound engineering and audio technology. I frequently research and stay updated with the latest tech through forums and online courses.
